title: Combine: Support Float16 datatype for OutTokens
body:
Support Float16 datatype for OutTokens
  - Replace hard coded `nv_bfloat16` with a Template type for outTokens in the combine kernel
  - Updated python and cpp `all_to_all` tests
  - Updated python and cpp benchmarks
author: varun-sundar-rabindranath
